setup.paymentDesc: After deployment, mock payment is enabled by default so you can try the full purchase flow. Real Alipay/WeChat collection requires your own merchant credentials and setup.
setup.paymentMockHint: Mock payment (MOCK) is enabled by default — no extra setup needed for testing.
setup.paymentRealHint: For Alipay/WeChat, configure keys under Orders → Payment Config and set notify URLs according to your deployment.
setup.paymentOrderHint: Alipay/WeChat are not configured yet. Set up keys here and enable the channel; notify URLs depend on your domain or tunnel setup.
setup.paymentConfigSteps: 1. Apply for Alipay/WeChat apps and obtain keys; 2. Fill in channel config below and enable; 3. Set PAYMENT_BASE_URL / PAYMENT_RETURN_URL env vars for your environment (not hardcoded).
